## Description {#details}

<p>An <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdnode">SDNode</a> that represents everything that will be needed to construct a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machineinstr">MachineInstr</a>.</p>


<p>These nodes are created during the instruction selection proper phase.</p>


<p>Note that the only supported way to set the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">memoperands</span> is by calling the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag/#a66ebc3ec1c8816b16a5f239a8631c780">SelectionDAG::setNodeMemRefs</a></span> function as the memory management happens inside the DAG rather than in the node.</p>


<p>Definition at line 3060 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/selectiondagnodes-h">SelectionDAGNodes.h</a>.</p>
